title: Noor and the Cover
author: S. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Delacroix, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
